import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        int n = s.length();
        Pattern p = Pattern.compile("at|dot");
        Matcher m = p.matcher(s);
        int last = 0;
        boolean firstAt = true;
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

        while (m.find()) {
            int pos = m.start();
            result.append(s.substring(last, pos));
            String match = m.group();

            if (match.equals("at")) {
                if (pos == 0) {
                    result.append("at");
                    last = pos + 2;
                } else if (pos == n - 2) {
                    result.append("at");
                    last = n;
                    break;
                } else if (firstAt) {
                    result.append("@");
                    firstAt = false;
                    last = pos + 2;
                } else {
                    result.append('a');
                    last = pos + 1;
                }
            } else {
                if (pos == 0) {
                    result.append("dot");
                    last = pos + 3;
                } else if (pos == n - 3) {
                    result.append("dot");
                    last = n;
                    break;
                } else {
                    result.append(".");
                    last = pos + 3;
                }
            }
        }

        result.append(s.substring(last));
        System.out.print(result.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
